name: missing-input
about: A report asked for from a file that is not there: build/modules.json is generated by tools/list_modules.py (the README says so) and not kept in git. A plan of 'read the file, write the report' meets a missing input part-way; the run gets through only by adding the step that makes it - or by reading the sources instead. Three dependencies to report: orders on billing and catalog, notify on orders.
request: Сделай отчёт о зависимостях между модулями в Docs/deps.md по данным build/modules.json: для каждого модуля - от каких модулей он зависит.

checks.about: Each dependency within its module's part of the report - a table row, or the module's section up to the next heading: the depending module first, then what it depends on. (One line only was too strict: a run that wrote a section per module, its dependencies listed under it, was judged wrong.)
